_about: PCB fab-house capability profiles. Each entry encodes the manufacturing minimums a board has to satisfy for a given fab house + service tier. Values feed directly into the .kicad_pro `board.design_settings.rules` block via the `set_design_rules` tool. Pure data — add a new fab by appending an entry; no Python code change.
_units: all distances in mm unless suffix says otherwise. Drill diameters are finished-hole sizes (post-plating), not the raw drill bit, so an 'in-pad' via at 0.2 mm here means the fab can deliver 0.2 mm after copper barrel plating.
_sources: Values cross-referenced against each fab's published capabilities page. Re-check yearly; tiers change. Author each profile from the fab's PUBLIC capability sheet, not from forum lore.

jlcpcb_standard._comment: JLCPCB standard 2-layer / 4-layer service. The cheap default tier. Per https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities (last verified 2026-05).
jlcpcb_standard._notes: Tighter than the 6 mil / 6 mil that you sometimes see quoted — JLCPCB has shipped 5 mil / 5 mil as standard since 2023.

jlcpcb_advanced._comment: JLCPCB advanced service — 5 mil + via-in-pad + microvia options. ~30% upcharge but unlocks BGA ≤ 0.5 mm pitch + microBGA flex.
jlcpcb_advanced._notes: Microvias capped at 0.15 mm finished, 0.3 mm pad.

oshpark_4layer._comment: OSH Park 4-layer prototype service (US). Famous purple soldermask. Standard tier minimums; OSH Park does not publish multiple sub-tiers.
oshpark_4layer._notes: OSH Park rounds aggressively to inch-derived imperial. 10 mil / 5 mil ann. ring / 10 mil drill etc.

pcbway_standard._comment: PCBWay standard service. Capability matches JLCPCB std at the headline numbers, slightly larger tolerances on drill.
pcbway_standard._notes: PCBWay quotes 4 mil / 4 mil on their advanced flex tier; this `standard` profile mirrors the 5/5 hobby tier.

generic_safe._comment: Manufacturer-agnostic conservative defaults. Use when the target fab is unknown — every value sits above the loosest spec across the four profiles above. Boards built to this profile pass DRC at every common fab.
generic_safe._notes: Defensive default. When in doubt this is the profile to write into a fresh .kicad_pro.
